description: SLURM knobs, the real-trainer memory measurement script and docs: FROZEN_INTEGRATION_GRID env in slurm/r_level2.sh and slurm/r_level1.sh (unset/empty = no flag), the key in r_cascade.sh LEVEL_ENV_KEYS, new slurm/fgi_memory.sh (plan D7), bash -n entry in tests/run_tests_wsl.sh, slurm tests, design.md 4.7 addendum and the first version of the report. Plan decisions D7-D8, items 5-6 (the full suite run belongs to the integration step). Needs FEAT-001's flag name; independent of FEAT-002.
steps: Read plan.md D7, D8 and the report-command block; read slurm/r_level2.sh, slurm/r_level1.sh, slurm/m11_fp32_width_memory.sh (structure to copy: header policy comments, env validation, per-config timeout, status.tsv, collector call, BGR_DRY_RUN), scripts/collect_memory_runs.py docstring.

slurm/r_level2.sh and slurm/r_level1.sh: FROZEN_INTEGRATION_GRID="${FROZEN_INTEGRATION_GRID:-}"; empty -> nothing; native|current -> GRID_ARGS="--frozen-integration-grid $FROZEN_INTEGRATION_GRID" added to MAIN just before $EXTRA_ARGS; anything else -> die (exit 2). Header comment paragraph: meaning, chain rule (level 1 inherits from its level-2 source; explicit mismatch fails in main.py), and the echo line. LF line endings, ASCII only.

slurm/r_cascade.sh: add FROZEN_INTEGRATION_GRID to LEVEL_ENV_KEYS and one header comment line: a fine-grid chain = EXTRA_ARGS_L2='--frozen-integration-grid current' (level 1 inherits it). No other change.

New slurm/fgi_memory.sh (SBATCH: --job-name=bgr-fgi-mem, -A qtim, -p rtx8000, --gpus=1, -N 1, --ntasks-per-node=1, --cpus-per-task=3, --mem=128G, --time=03:00:00, --output/--error under /autofs/space/crater_001/users/jn85/BrainRegProjects/GroupwiseReg/logs/%x-%j.{out,err}; 'set -uo pipefail'; header with purpose, configs, expected numbers from plan D6, time estimate (~2 h), 'DO NOT submit without Jay's approval', 'at most two active jobs', mkdir -p logs line and the sbatch line). Env: PROJ, REPO, DATA, SIF, SCRATCH_ROOT, L4_SOURCE (default $PROJ/results/r4_cfgB_dice1_smooth2_lr3e-4_wd1e-1/ckpt/last), GROUP_ARGS ('--group-config B'), SMOOTH (10), STEPS (16), VAL_EVERY (8), BN_RECAL_BATCHES (4), CONFIG_TIMEOUT (3600), ONLY, BGR_DRY_RUN. OUT=$PROJ/scratch/fgi/${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}. Configs in order l2_native l2_current l1_native l1_current; per config build the env (RESULTS=$OUT/runs RUN_NAME=<name> STEPS VAL_EVERY CKPT_EVERY=0 BN_RECAL_BATCHES PROJECT_STEPS=$STEPS EXTRA_ARGS="$GROUP_ARGS --lambda-smooth $SMOOTH" CASCADE_FROM=<L4_SOURCE | $OUT/runs/l2_<grid>/ckpt/last> plus FROZEN_INTEGRATION_GRID=current for *_current), get the recipe by running `env <...> BGR_DRY_RUN=1 bash $REPO/slurm/r_level<k>.sh` and taking the 'MAIN: python ' line (argv = the words after 'MAIN: python '), then run `timeout -k 60 $CONFIG_TIMEOUT singularity exec --nv -B /scratch -B /autofs -B /cluster -B /space -B /vast $SIF python <argv>` with a per-config nvidia-smi poll into $OUT/runs/<name>/gpu_poll.csv (pattern of r_level1.sh POLL_CMD) and the TMPDIR / KERAS_HOME / CUDA_CACHE exports of r_level1.sh; log to $OUT/runs/<name>.log; append a status.tsv row (columns name level dtype widths n max_pairs rc elapsed_s log; dtype = native|current, widths = d12hs, n = deform N 16/4, max_pairs 64). An L1 line whose L2 source run has no ckpt/last/checkpoint gets rc -2 and is not run. L1 ckpt dirs are deleted after their config (L2 ckpts kept: they are the L1 sources). Finally `singularity exec -B /autofs -B /cluster -B /space $SIF python scripts/collect_memory_runs.py --status $OUT/status.tsv --runs $OUT/runs --out $OUT/fgi_memory.json --skip-steps 2 --job $JOB_ID`; exit code = the collector's. BGR_DRY_RUN=1: validate env (L4_SOURCE must be a directory or <prefix>.index, exit 2 otherwise; unknown ONLY names exit 2), print one line per selected config 'CONFIG <name>: <env assignments> bash slurm/r_level<k>.sh' and exit 0 before any mkdir / file write / singularity call.
tests/run_tests_wsl.sh: add slurm/fgi_memory.sh to the bash -n list (the `for s in ...` line).

tests/test_slurm_scripts.py: (a) TestStubRuns-style: r_level2.sh and r_level1.sh with FROZEN_INTEGRATION_GRID unset -> calls identical to today's and no '--frozen-integration-grid'; =current -> exactly one ' --frozen-integration-grid current ' in the main.py call and the argv parses with runtime.args.parse_args (as TestM11Job does); =bogus -> exit 2, no calls. (b) TestFgiMemory: header lines (exact SBATCH set, qtim, no 'entre', LF, ASCII, approval note, mkdir -p logs); dry run with a temp L4_SOURCE dir -> 4 CONFIG lines in order, *_current lines carry FROZEN_INTEGRATION_GRID=current, l1_* CASCADE_FROM = $OUT/runs/l2_<grid>/ckpt/last; ONLY=l2_current selects one line; missing L4_SOURCE and unknown ONLY -> exit 2 with nothing created; a stub run (fake singularity / nvidia-smi on PATH, stub collector via the singularity stub) writes status.tsv with 4 rows and gives rc -2 to the L1 lines when the stub L2 runs leave no checkpoint. (c) TestCascadeStatic.test_level_env_coverage still passes.

.agents/tasks/network-design/design.md: append a short addendum after section 4.7's cascade text: 'Optional fine-grid frozen integration' (flag names, semantics at L2 / L1, chain rule, inference default auto, default native = unchanged).

Write .agents/tasks/fine-grid-integration/report.md (worktree): design decisions D1-D9 (short), flag names, chain rule, memory/time estimate per level (plan D6, unmeasured), exact sbatch commands (plan.md 'Report sbatch commands' block; memory job + L2 smoke from results/r4_cfgB_dice1_smooth2_lr3e-4_wd1e-1/ckpt/last with --group-config B), how to read the results (fgi_memory.json gpu_peak_gib, gpu_poll.csv max memory.used <= total - 512 MiB, L1 current within 42500 MB with >= 1 GB headroom), predict usage (auto default; --integration-grid fine / native), placeholders for commit hashes and full-suite results (filled by the integration step).
Run tests.test_slurm_scripts (bgr_preproc38, TF-free) and bash -n on the four scripts in WSL; commit locally: 'fine-grid integration: slurm knobs, fgi_memory.sh, docs'.
acceptance_criteria: python -m unittest tests.test_slurm_scripts -v passes in bgr_preproc38 without importing TF (incl. test_level_env_coverage).
With FROZEN_INTEGRATION_GRID unset the main.py command lines of r_level2.sh / r_level1.sh / r_cascade.sh dry runs are byte-identical to the base commit's.
slurm/fgi_memory.sh passes bash -n, its dry run prints the 4 configs and creates nothing.
report.md exists with the sbatch commands; design.md has the addendum.
verification: WSL: bash -n slurm/fgi_memory.sh slurm/r_level2.sh slurm/r_level1.sh slurm/r_cascade.sh
findings: Commit 289be0d on branch fine-grid-integration (8 files: slurm/r_level2.sh, slurm/r_level1.sh, slurm/r_cascade.sh, new slurm/fgi_memory.sh, tests/run_tests_wsl.sh, tests/test_slurm_scripts.py, .agents/tasks/network-design/design.md, .agents/tasks/fine-grid-integration/report.md; report.md is the only tracked file under .agents/tasks/fine-grid-integration/). Scripts: r_level2.sh / r_level1.sh read FROZEN_INTEGRATION_GRID="${FROZEN_INTEGRATION_GRID:-}" after MEM_ARGS; non-empty -> need_choice native current (die exit 2, message 'FROZEN_INTEGRATION_GRID must be one of: native current (got ...)') and GRID_ARGS="--frozen-integration-grid V"; MAIN ends '... $SYNTH_ARGS $GRID_ARGS $EXTRA_ARGS)'; non-dry runs print 'frozen integration grid: <value | not set (...)>'; header paragraph 'Fine-grid frozen integration' just before set -euo pipefail. r_cascade.sh: FROZEN_INTEGRATION_GRID appended to LEVEL_ENV_KEYS (new last line) + header line under EXTRA_ARGS_L*: "(fine-grid chain: EXTRA_ARGS_L2='--frozen-integration-grid current'; level 1 inherits it)". slurm/fgi_memory.sh: SBATCH bgr-fgi-mem / qtim / rtx8000 / 1 GPU / 3 CPUs / 128G / 03:00:00, set -uo pipefail; env PROJ REPO DATA SIF SCRATCH_ROOT L4_SOURCE GROUP_ARGS (${GROUP_ARGS---group-config B}) SMOOTH 10 STEPS 16 VAL_EVERY 8 BN_RECAL_BATCHES 4 CONFIG_TIMEOUT 3600 ONLY BGR_DRY_RUN; OUT=$PROJ/scratch/fgi/<job>; validation (exit 2 before any write, also without dry run): STEPS >= 2, SMOOTH number, CONFIG_TIMEOUT >= 1, L4_SOURCE dir or <prefix>.index, REPO has slurm/r_level{2,1}.sh, ONLY names known. Dry run line format: 'CONFIG <name>: RESULTS=.. RUN_NAME=.. STEPS=16 VAL_EVERY=8 CKPT_EVERY=0 BN_RECAL_BATCHES=4 PROJECT_STEPS=16 EXTRA_ARGS='--group-config B --lambda-smooth 10' CASCADE_FROM=.. [FROZEN_INTEGRATION_GRID=current] bash slurm/r_level<k>.sh' (shell-quoted with the r_cascade shq rule). Run: per config the level script's dry run under `env -i` (PATH HOME PROJ REPO DATA SIF SCRATCH_ROOT SLURM_JOB_ID SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK + config env) -> first 'MAIN: python ' line split into words -> `timeout -k 60 $CONFIG_TIMEOUT singularity exec --nv -B /scratch -B /autofs -B /cluster -B /space -B /vast $SIF python <argv>` from cd $REPO, log runs/<name>.log, nvidia-smi poll runs/<name>/gpu_poll.csv; a failed level dry run writes its output to the log and gets its rc (2 if no MAIN line); status.tsv rows dtype = native|current, widths d12hs, n 16 (L2) / 4 (L1), max_pairs 64; L1 without $RUNS/l2_<grid>/ckpt/last/checkpoint -> rc -2; L1 ckpt dirs removed after the config; collector with --skip-steps 2 --job $JOB_ID, exit = collector's. Deviations: (1) l1_current passes FROZEN_INTEGRATION_GRID=current explicitly (as FEAT-003 step 4 says) although it would be inherited; main.py checks it against the source. (2) the level scripts are called with `env -i` (not in the step text) so stale recipe env of the submitting shell cannot leak (same purpose as r_cascade's unset of LEVEL_ENV_KEYS). (3) report.md row FEAT-003 says '(this commit, see git log)' and the full-suite row is TODO for the integration step.
